task: Classify immune infiltration level in glioblastoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune class. On H&E, focus on the amount and distribution of lymphocytes and other inflammatory cells, including perivascular cuffing and inflammatory infiltrates within viable tumor and around necrosis.

classes.0: Low immune class with scant inflammatory cells and minimal lymphocytic infiltration in or around the tumor.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate but not diffuse inflammatory infiltrate within the tumor microenvironment.
classes.2: High immune class with conspicuous dense immune-cell infiltration, including prominent perivascular or intratumoral inflammatory aggregates.
